results.question: When does URLCodec.decodeUrl(BitSet, byte[]) turn a plus into a space instead of preserving the plus?
results.answer: Only when plus is not marked safe and space is marked safe. If plus is safe, it is preserved; if space is not safe, plus is copied unchanged.

citations.excerpt: A percent sign marked safe is copied literally; otherwise it starts a two-digit hexadecimal escape. A plus sign marked safe is copied literally. Otherwise, a plus sign becomes a space only if space is marked safe. All other bytes are copied unchanged.
